description: Site-wide navbar: logo, two dropdown menus (Products, Resources), Sign In / Get Started CTAs, mobile hamburger. Shared across all 15 Layout-wrapped routes. Dropdown menus reference two real-but-unmounted routes (/secondary-vehicles, /control-os) — see extraction/measured-values.json 'deadNavLinks' note; do not treat these as pages to generate.

motion.dropdown: opens on hover, closes after 150ms mouseleave delay, unmounts 200ms after close (motion.patterns not applicable, component-local timers)
motion.reducedMotionFallback: dropdown opens/closes instantly, no enter transition class
